thread:
kevin: kickoff for tonight's rollout. order: US -> EU -> APAC. window 20:30-23:00 PT. plan: 1% -> 4% -> 20% -> full. APAC manual hold due to cooling window.
anya: quick warm-pool check before we start?
ops-bot: capacity snapshot: US(us-west-2) free=184 total=300; EU(eu-west-1) free=62 total=120; APAC(ap-southeast-1) free=28 total=80. command: `opsctl capacity --regions us,eu,apac --short`
mike: noted. APAC has scheduled infra reboot at 02:00 local; keep manual hold.
kevin: monitoring thresholds: error_rate >= 1% over 5m OR p95 increase > +150ms triggers rollback. @hana you'll watch dash?
hana: on it. setting alert mute rules for noisy retriers. I'll shout on the channel if anything spikes.
kevin: @deploy-bot start US canary 1% version=v1.2.3 pin=true fallback=v1.2.2
deploy-bot: canary started: id cb-1753214321 region=us percent=1 version=v1.2.3 fallback=v1.2.2
anya: enabling KV cache prefill for canary. payload: `curl -X POST https://internal/cache/prefill -d '{"canary":"cb-1753214321","regions":["us"]}'`
hana: 7m check: p95=198ms, error_rate=0.04%, cpu=70% looks stable. hold 10m before step.
mike: thermal note: US pools healthy. EU nominal. APAC on manual hold.
deploy-bot: waiting 10m gate before stepping to 4% in US. next update +10m.
kevin: rollout playbook reminder: staged rollback = cancel canary, promote fallback, then evaluate cross-region impact. rollback snippet in runbook: `redwoodctl rollout cancel cb-1753214321 && redwoodctl promote --version v1.2.2 --region us`
hana: 11m: stepping to 4% now. watching error_rate and p95.
deploy-bot: canary cb-1753214321 stepped to 4% (region=us)
ops-bot: updated capacity: US free=176, EU free=61, APAC free=28. no thermal alerts.
hana: 16m at 4%: error_rate=0.12%, p95=225ms, no alarms. green to queue EU 1% but keep EU manual for 20m observation.
anya: queue growth in us-west-2 tokens +8% baseline, not critical. mike will watch backend retriers.
mike: saw a transient 429 spike from a downstream batcher at +2m, cleared quickly. not user-facing. muted noisy alert.
release-manager: (typo) oops — meant release-manager: drafting announcement to post after EU 1% kickoff: "Rolling v1.2.3: US at 4% stable; EU queued; APAC manual hold. Follow #eng-releases for live updates."
kevin: if EU 1% goes green for 20m then we'll reassess APAC cooling window and potentially open APAC at 1% with strict autoscale limits.
hana: 25m check: US stable. I'll keep a 30m buffer before EU progression. posting live metrics link: https://dash.internal/rollouts/1753214321
deploy-bot: EU canary queued; waiting for operator approval (manual hold flag set for APAC).
kevin: thanks all. next sync in 20m or on any alarm. :thumbsup:
